catalog_policy.brand_presence_rule: A fashion-relevant brand discovered at an audited department store is eligible for BrandCatalog even when no trustworthy numeric brand size chart exists.
catalog_policy.sizing_independence: Sizing quality must never be used as a reason to omit an otherwise valid fashion brand from the catalog.
catalog_policy.verified_priority: Verified product-specific or brand-specific numeric sizing always takes priority over generic sizing.

generic_fallback.label: Estimated size
generic_fallback.notes: The fallback is derived from customer body measurements and available product alpha-size labels. It is not represented as a precise brand chart and is automatically superseded by verified product or brand sizing.

retailer_audit_scope.dynamic_retailer_note: Off-price and dynamically faceted retailers cannot be truthfully represented as permanently exhaustive. Newly discovered fashion brands are added without waiting for verified sizing.
